最近，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj]似乎迷上了我们的外表。我们的[Species.GetEarNamePlural]似乎让他们联想到了他们的幼体。事实上，他们形容我们非常“可爱”。一种长着夸张[Species.GetEarNamePlural]的填充玩具在他们的城市里已经成了一等一的抢手货。
texts.en:
Unexpected news from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as a familiar face greets us: our own.

Recently, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj] have become captivated by our form. Something about our [Species.GetEarNamePlural] seems to remind them of their young. In fact, they say that we are 'Cute.' Already, stuffed toys with exaggerated [Species.GetEarNamePlural] have become a wide-spread commodity in their cities.
